constants.UNREAD: an amount FERB couldn't read on the page
constants.ACCOUNT_SECURITY: a password, two-factor or recovery setting, or deleting the account
constants.TLS_QUESTION: Run this with certificate checks turned off? `{command}` — this skips the check that {site}

CODE_RUNNERS.com.apple.systemevents: System Events, whose keystrokes type into whatever has the keyboard focus
CODE_RUNNERS.com.apple.finder: Finder, which opens files with their default apps (a .command runs in Terminal) and copies files with its own access, past FERB's protection lists

constants.UNASKED: FERB types into a terminal only after the owner's Yes to that exact input (D31): this input would reach {why} in {app}, and the call carries no Yes for it, so nothing was typed. Run commands with FERB's shell tool; if FERB's sandbox blocks a command you need, request the escape hatch (shell.rules lists what it lifts), which asks the owner once
